task_name: Implement staged pipeline and atomic immutable publication

concerns_addressed: Failed run preserves previous active snapshot; error/failed_section lineage recorded and no partial snapshot created.
Empty source window publishes versioned empty snapshot with snapshot_version and window metadata; prior audit history retained.
ActiveDataSnapshotReader selects exactly is_active=true AND status=published, returns typed section payloads plus snapshot_version and window; hides staged/failed rows; contains no mutation behavior.

strengths: Deterministic Asia/Jakarta window via computeWindow with inclusive 30-day rolling.
Atomic staging-to-published promotion in single DB::transaction with lockForUpdate plus partial unique index guard.
Single read-only read seam with no create/update/delete/publish surface.

issues.description: DataPipelineService.php ~305 lines and run()/publishSnapshot() ~70 lines near heuristics but intentionally unsplit per packet bounded-refactor rule (extract only if 3x identical serialization).
ActiveDataSnapshotReader::section() fallback re-queries snapshot()/window() per mapped row instead of caching the active snapshot/version/window at method entry.
Magic status strings repeated across service and tests without Status enum/constants; no behavior impact.
